blocks.title: Which rule prices a product
items: Of all enabled rules the most specific one wins:

items.text: only when pricing a document of that supplier
applies only to products in the list (up to 5000, manually or from Excel/CSV)
with all subcategories; the category closest to the product wins

items: Within one level — the lower “Priority” number.

blocks.title: Important
items: The price is calculated from the purchase price; a product without one is not repriced.
“Apply to all” recalculates every product in the rule's scope, but each gets the price of its own winning rule. A disabled rule cannot be applied.
